senses.gloss: m. (טָפַף I) addition to city limits, suburb; pr. n. pl. Tefef.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 75b:5-9">B. Bath. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>עתיד … אלף ט׳ גינואות</he> in the future the Lord shall add to Jerusalem one thousand times the area of Tefef for gardens; Yalk. Zech. 568 (for Var. lect., v. Rabb. D. S. to B. Bath. l. c. note 40. Comment. takes <he>טפ״ף</he> as numerals = 169).
